questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Paraphernalia”
answer: The archaeologist carefully unpacked her paraphernalia—brushes, chisels, and measuring tools—before approaching the ancient ruins.

questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Corral”
answer: The ranchers worked swiftly to corral the wild horses before the storm rolled in from the west.

questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Profusely”
answer: He apologised profusely, his voice trembling with regret as he tried to undo the damage his words had caused.

questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Splintered”
answer: The old door splintered under the weight of the blow, sending jagged shards across the dusty floor.

questions.question:
Write about an experience where you encountered something unlucky, or when you believed something to be a result of bad luck.
Try to use any of the following literary devices in your writing:
  • Metaphor
  • Simile
  • Personification
  • Idiom
